_source: Portal Repository, read 2026-09-07, via the Suika Box guides 21.multitool-damage.md and 14.starships-ranked.md. The verified field is the address; class and slot claims are submitter metadata and rot.
_note: Portal addresses worth keeping. Hand-editable; the TUI writes here too (portals screen, s). galaxy is 1-based: 1 is Euclid.

_schema.name: what you call it
_schema.kind: multi-tool | starship | freighter | base | planet | system | other
_schema.origin: mine | shared - your own find, or somebody else's
_schema.detail: what is there - class, type, slot count
_schema.where: how to find it once you arrive
_schema.source: who shared it, or where you found it
_schema.added: YYYY-MM-DD, stamped when the TUI saves it
